description: Linux kernel watchdog driver for Gateworks Avila hardware, based on IXP4xx network processor watchdog, implementing device initialization, control, and timer management.

methods.name: wdt_refresh
methods.description: Timer callback to refresh watchdog, decrement counter, and reset GPIO.

methods.name: wdt_enable
methods.description: Enables the watchdog timer, initializes GPIO and counter.

methods.name: wdt_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog timer, re-enables clock output.

methods.name: avila_wdt_open
methods.description: Opens the watchdog device, sets in-use bit, and enables watchdog.

methods.name: avila_wdt_write
methods.description: Handles write to watchdog device, resets timer if needed.

methods.name: avila_wdt_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for watchdog control and status.

methods.name: avila_wdt_release
methods.description: Releases the watchdog device, disables timer if allowed.

methods.name: avila_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog module, sets up timer and device.

methods.name: avila_wdt_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the watchdog module, deregisters device and timer.
